class.name: OcgGCMakearcofhyperbola
class.brief_description: Implements construction algorithms for hyperbola arcs in 3D space. The result is a `Geom_TrimmedCurve`. A MakeArcOfHyperbola object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the arc of hyperbola, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the results. In particular, the Value function returns the constructed arc of hyperbola.
